problem_statement: Build a brand-new Audit Log page from scratch at the /audit-log route of this Material Tailwind dashboard. The route does not exist yet (empty/404 in baseline). Mount the new page inside the existing dashboard shell (sidebar, top bar, footer) so it matches the rest of the site. The page shows a table of recent audit events, each with a severity and how long ago it happened. Add two filter controls that work TOGETHER: a severity selector (All / Critical / Warning / Info) and a date-range selector (Last 7 days / Last 30 days / All time); the table shows only events matching BOTH. Paginate the results, and CRUCIALLY the active filters must persist while paging through results (moving to the next page must keep the current filter, not reset it). A live heading reflects the active severity and the current page. The page must be usable on a phone with no horizontal scrolling, and adding this page must not break the existing dashboard home.
required_content: The page is reachable at /audit-log and renders inside the existing dashboard shell (shared sidebar + top navbar + footer).
A card titled 'Audit Log' with a gradient header, matching the dashboard's existing card style.
A severity filter offering All, Critical, Warning and Info choices.
A date-range filter offering Last 7 days, Last 30 days and All time.
A live heading that names the currently-selected severity and the current page position.
A results table listing audit events with columns for the event, the actor, when it happened, and a coloured severity chip.
The two filters combine: choosing a severity AND a date range narrows the table to events matching both.
Pagination controls (Previous / Next) that page through the matching events.
The active filter selection persists while paginating — moving to the next page keeps the filter applied, it does not reset to All.
The whole page fits a narrow phone screen with no sideways scrolling.
The pre-existing dashboard home page still renders correctly (shared shell + its Projects/Orders content intact) after the new page is added.
design_constraints: Reuse the site's Material Tailwind design system (Card, CardHeader gradient gray, Typography, Button, Chip, blue-gray tokens) and the existing dashboard chrome (Sidenav + DashboardNavbar + Footer).
No new network fetches — the audit data is static and self-contained so the page renders deterministically.

Palette (match the dashboard tokens): blue-gray text/borders rgb(96,125,139) (#607d8b) with darker blue-gray rgb(38,50,56) for emphasis; white card surfaces (#ffffff) on a light gray page (#f5f7f8); font family Roboto, sans-serif; rounded corners ~8px; severity chips are coloured (e.g. red for Critical, amber/orange for Warning, blue for Info).
Table columns, in order, use the uppercase headers EVENT, ACTOR, WHEN, SEVERITY; the filter controls are labelled SEVERITY and DATE RANGE.

The live heading is an h3 of the form "Showing <severity> events, Page <n> of <total>" (e.g. "Showing All events, Page 1 of 4"); when the Critical severity is selected it reads "Showing Critical events, ..." and this selected severity stays in the heading while paginating.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /audit-log(顶层空 route element=<></>,不落 catch-all 重定向); reference 完整实现 severity+date-range 双筛选+分页,筛选跨翻页持久; bad 复制 reference 但让翻页 handler 重置两个筛选(state-linked 持久性被破坏,仅 interaction_assertions 失败)。回归门: 新增页面后既有 dashboard home 仍渲染(共享 chrome + Projects/Orders 内容)。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。BrowserRouter basename=/material-tailwind-dashboard-react → 采集 path 必须带前缀。
